validity.recommendation: Check diameter, length and capacity against the operator's technical passport. The operator calls this a DN500 line, older Ukrtransgaz literature describes two lines of 530 and 720 mm, and the sheet says one 800 mm line with 8 bcm a year.
validity.researcher_notes: The line is real. The operator, Gas TSO of Ukraine, issued a June 2020 notice about technical works on its DN500 Komarno-Drozdovychi pipeline at the Hermanowice border point. A Russian news agency report from February 2022 says gas flowed through it at about 8 million cubic meters a day. It is a cross-border transmission link to Poland, correctly classed as gas. It is not a duplicate of the cancelled Poland-Ukraine Interconnector (P1487), which is a new line to Bilche-Volytsia. The sheet says 800 mm. The operator says DN500. The Ukrainian Wikipedia corridor article describes two parallel lines with about 5 billion cubic meters a year combined, against the sheet's 8. The earlier pass found the same split. The geocoder error that put the start in Slovakia is already known, and the 80 km length is plausible against about 78 km per line.

Searched English, Ukrainian and Russian for a rated capacity of the Komarno-Drozdovychi line. Found no source stating 8 bcm a year. The Ukrainian Wikipedia corridor article says the two lines together carry about 5 billion cubic meters a year. The Interfax figure of 8 million cubic meters a day is a flow, not a rating. The operator's 2025 border capacity notices cover the interconnection point, not this line. The value stays and is flagged as a concern.

No page verified today states 800 mm for this line. The operator's June 2020 notice calls it a DN500 pipeline. A search snippet from the Ukrtransgaz history page describes the Komarno to border route as two lines, 530 mm and 720 mm, about 78 km each. That page returns 403 here and was not read. The earlier pass relied on a Polish operator press release that this pass could not match by name. The 800 mm value is left as is and flagged as a concern.

Searched for the length of the Komarno-Drozdovychi line. Only a search snippet from the Ukrtransgaz history page gives about 78.3 and 78.4 km for the two Komarno to border lines. That page returns 403 and was not read. No verified page states 80 km. The sheet value is close to the snippet but is not confirmed.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: The only page I could read that names the line is from February 2022 and shows gas flowing. Search results show the Poland to Ukraine border point was in active use through 2025 and into 2026: the operator and the Polish operator doubled firm import capacity from 1 July 2025, and a May 2026 Forbes Ukraine report covers a new stage of capacity growth. I could not read any 2024 or later page that names the Komarno-Drozdovychi line itself, so this confirms the Ukrainian border link in use, not the line by name. Operating stays.

summary: Real operating cross-border gas link; spec concern on diameter (800 vs operator DN500) and capacity (8 vs about 5 bcm/y); capacity, diameter, length, start unresolved
